name: Harper Agent
description: Origin Feat You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Instrument Training
features.description: You gain proficiency with a Musical Instrument of your choice.

features.name: Distracting Melody
features.description: When you take the Help action to assist an ally’s attack roll, the enemy you’re distracting can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet of you, provided the enemy can see or hear you.
